title: New Conditions for Philosophers to Catch the Wave of Citizen Deliberation in the Age of Artificial Intelligence

bias_targets.methodology: Proposing an evaluation framework based on democratic indicators to assess AI outputs across five civic roles (moderation, translation, summarization, writing assistance, and facilitation) for discrimination or favoritism toward certain ideas, positions, or ideologies.
Applying democratic indicators to AI-assisted civic roles to check for representation biases and discrimination against citizen groups based on age.
Applying democratic indicators to AI-assisted civic roles to check for representation biases and discrimination against citizen groups based on gender.
Applying democratic indicators to AI-assisted civic roles to check for representation biases and discrimination against citizen groups based on ethnicity.
Applying democratic indicators to AI-assisted civic roles to check for representation biases and discrimination against citizen groups based on social categories.
Assessing AI translation capabilities and roles within civic platforms to determine if the model translates certain languages better than others or discriminates for or against certain languages.
